title: fix(platform-objects,metadata-core,service-messaging): Setup descriptions are plain admin sentences; ADR references move to the docblocks
body:
Fixes #23802

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The sentence an administrator reads under a Setup page title is the object's `description`; a field's help tooltip is the field's `description`. Both reach every locale through the generated translation bundles. This PR rewrites the Setup-visible object descriptions in the admin's words and moves every ADR number, decision id and API call out of the strings in this lane's packages and into the docblock or a comment beside the string (the card's constraint: docblocks and ADR links in code stay, only user-facing strings move). Wording only: no field, index, permission or behaviour change.

Scope at the claim: `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata*.object.ts` and `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/*.object.ts`. The descriptions produced in `plugin-approvals`, `plugin-security`, `service-automation`, `plugin-sharing` and `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` (the permission set `organization_admin_no_bypass`, Record Shares, Approval Delegations) belong to #23829, which remains open and is untouched here.

## Before / after

Measured by loading the BUILT object definitions of the three packages (61 objects; multi-line values included) and matching the card's patterns (`ADR-` followed by a digit, a decision id such as D2, `finding F`, `emit()`, `kernel`). Before, at base `1ecb08a1c`: 15 distinct strings matched (17 rows; two metadata-core strings appear twice because platform-objects re-exports them). After, at `a6586f72a`: 0.

Object descriptions on a Setup page, rewritten (the last two carried schema vocabulary and no pattern):

| Object (Setup nav entry) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `sys_business_unit` (People and Organization, Business Units) | Canonical Business Unit tree — hierarchical org/data-partition node (company / division / department / region / office). ADR-0057 D2. | Your company structure — divisions, departments, regions and offices — used to scope data and reports. |
| `sys_notification` (Diagnostics, Notification Events) | Notification events — one row per emit() (ADR-0030 Layer 2 ingress) | Every notification the platform sent, one row per event. |
| `sys_http_delivery` (Integrations, HTTP Deliveries) | Durable outbox row for one outbound-HTTP attempt (ADR-0018). Managed by @objectstack/service-messaging; do not write directly. | Outgoing HTTP calls made by webhooks and flows, one row per call, with its delivery status. |
| `sys_notification_preference` (Configuration, Notification Preferences) | Per-user × topic × channel notification toggle (mute/allow), with admin-global defaults. | Which topics and channels each user receives; admins set the defaults. |
| `sys_notification_template` (Configuration, Notification Templates) | Per (topic × channel × locale) render template for notifications. | The subject and body each notification topic sends, per channel and language. |

Field help on Setup forms: the ADR reference is removed and the rest of the help text is unchanged, because it is operational detail an admin acts on.

- `sys_user.role`: "(ADR-0068 D2)" removed
- `sys_user.manager_id`: "(ADR-0057 / @objectstack/security-enterprise)" removed
- `sys_user.primary_business_unit_id`: "(ADR-0057 addendum D12)" removed
- `sys_organization.parent_organization_id`: "(ADR-0105 D6)" removed
- `sys_invitation.business_unit_id` and `sys_invitation.positions`: "(ADR-0105 D8)" removed
- `sys_sso_provider.domain_verified` (Access Control, SSO Providers): "(ADR-0135 D6)" removed

Judged NOT Setup-visible (no Setup nav entry in any of the 12 contributors that declare `app: 'setup'`, and not the subject of a Setup record page); the ADR reference is removed and the wording is otherwise kept:

- `sys_metadata_audit` (metadata-core): "(ADR-0010)" removed
- `sys_metadata_commit` (metadata-core; in no translation bundle): "(ADR-0067)" removed
- `sys_metadata.environment_id` (metadata-core): "(ADR-0131 D6)" removed
- `sys_metadata_activation` (platform-objects; in no translation bundle): "(ADR-0126 §4)" removed. It backs the Packaged Automation page, which renders its own copy rather than this description.
- `sys_notification_delivery` (service-messaging): "(ADR-0030 Layer 4)" removed

They are edited anyway because they sit in the claimed file surface, three of them ship in the platform-objects bundles to every locale, and the test below then pins every object a package ships. No hand-kept Setup roster is needed, so it cannot go stale when a plugin adds a nav entry.

Setup nav labels and the `SETUP_APP` description carried none of the patterns. No nav string changed.

## Translations: what the generator required

`os i18n extract` (run for all nine bundle sets by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, which reads each package's documented command) rewrites the `en` bundle from source on every run. It keeps any non-empty translated-locale value (merge mode). A translated leaf whose source moved is therefore NOT updated by the generator. Its own generated header says to re-translate it by hand. So the order was:

1. platform-objects zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES `objects` bundles: the 11 affected leaves re-translated in place (leaf values only, no key added or removed). None of them had a recorded source hash, so the provenance tables did not move.
2. service-messaging zh-CN: the 4 affected descriptions re-translated in place.
3. service-messaging ja-JP / es-ES: these bundles are untranslated English fills with recorded provenance, so the 4 stale fills were emptied and the generator re-filled them from the new source. It refreshed their entries in `ja-JP` / `es-ES.source-hashes.generated.ts` itself. If they had been left alone, both locales would have kept a byte-identical superseded draft, which `check:i18n-stale-fill` exists to catch.
4. `check-i18n-bundles --write` regenerated the `en` bundles and the hash tables. `pnpm check:i18n` and `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill` are green after it.

## Acceptance 1: tests in the packages' own suites

No new `check:*` script, lint rule or CI wiring.

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` covers four populations: every object this package and `@objectstack/metadata-core` export (each `label` / `pluralLabel` / `description` anywhere in the definition); every leaf of the four `objects` bundles; the type-level `label` / `description` of the four `metadataForms` bundles (the sentence a Setup metadata page such as Capabilities shows); and `SETUP_APP` plus `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` plus each locale's `apps.setup` subtree. It also has a positive control showing the matcher recognises each kind of vocabulary.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` applies the same rule to every messaging object and its four bundles. platform-objects cannot import service-messaging, and no dependency was added for a test.
- Patterns are case-sensitive except `kernel`. The decision-id pattern uses word boundaries and matched no legitimate text in any population. The one lower-case hit in the instrument run, `adr-0104-file-references` (a migration id inside `sys_migration.id`'s help), is a machine id; the case-sensitive pattern does not match it.

Ablation: four legs through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- (A) an ADR reference re-added to the Business Units source description turned the object test red, naming `sys_business_unit.description`.
- (B) the old `emit()` / ADR sentence put back into the zh-CN bundle turned the zh-CN bundle test red.
- (C) an ADR reference added to the messaging preference description turned the messaging object test red.
- (D) an ADR reference added to `sys_metadata_commit`, with metadata-core rebuilt, turned the object test red. `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the marker was present in 4 dist files. Restore leg: rebuild, then `--absent` confirmed the marker gone from all 12 dist files with a clean tree, and the suite was green again.

## Local verification (HEAD `a6586f72a`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 71 files, 1103 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: 51 files, 574 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core test`: 18 files, 733 passed (run at `3b5ffa17f`; nothing in metadata-core changed after it).
- `typecheck` for all three packages: exit 0. Both new test files are in their tsc programs (counted with `--listFiles`).
- `pnpm check:i18n`, `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill` and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`: exit 0.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 66 families): 65 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, it reads every package's dist and this worktree built only the CLI closure); that is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- `sys_notification_subscription` keeps its description ("Standing subscription of a principal (role/team/user) to a notification topic."). Its docblock records that the subscription-to-recipient expansion is not wired, so the Setup grid is admin-authored data, not routing. Any user-voice sentence of the "who receives this topic" kind would advertise behaviour the runtime does not deliver.
- Not Setup-visible, schema vocabulary, no pattern, left as is: `sys_inbox_message`, `sys_notification_receipt` ("Per-recipient × channel receipt …") and `sys_business_unit_member` (shown only as a related list, which renders the label).
- `SETUP_APP.protection.reason` ("… see ADR-0010.") is a lock reason, not a nav label or description. Not edited.
- Out of this lane, reported to the PM rather than edited:
  - Setup's Permission Sets and Positions forms show spec form help that carries ADR numbers. Producers: `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts` (`isDefault`, `managedBy`, `packageId`, `adminScope`) and `packages/spec/src/identity/position.form.ts` (`delegatable`).
  - The "Installed Apps" note the card quotes is produced in objectui (`packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, key `installedAdditiveNote`, rendered by `InstalledListWidget.tsx`), not by `cloud-connection`.
- The Studio-only metadata-form help texts in the same bundles (object, field, view, action, agent, skill) also carry ADR numbers. They are spec copy outside Setup and were not judged here.
